## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-api-sd-incoterms-srv-setup-gu`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a communication user

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system as an administrator. -->
2. <!-- manual: Open the Maintain Communication Users app from the SAP Fiori Launchpad. -->
3. Select **New** to create a new user.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a User Name (e.g., INCOTERMS_API_USER) and a Description. -->
5. <!-- manual: Set a Password and confirm it: record this password, as it will be used when configuring the connector. -->
6. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Create a communication system

1. <!-- manual: Open the Communication Systems app from the SAP Fiori Launchpad. -->
2. Select **New** and enter a **System ID** (e.g., `BALLERINA_INCOTERMS`) and a **System Name**.
3. <!-- manual: Select New and enter a System ID (e.g., BALLERINA_INCOTERMS) and a System Name. -->
4. <!-- manual: Under Technical Data, enter the Host Name of your integration host or leave it as a placeholder. -->
5. Under **Users for Inbound Communication**, select **+** and assign the communication user created in the previous step.
6. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Create a communication arrangement

1. <!-- manual: Open the Communication Arrangements app from the SAP Fiori Launchpad. -->
2. Select **New**.
3. <!-- manual: In the Scenario field, search for and select the communication scenario that exposes API_SD_INCOTERMS_SRV. This is typically associated with Sales and Distribution master data scenarios. -->
4. <!-- manual: In the Communication System field, select the system created in the previous step. -->
5. After saving, note the **Service URL** shown in the arrangement details: the hostname portion of this URL (e.g., `my-tenant.s4hana.cloud.sap`) is required by the connector.
6. Select **Save**.
